title: Finite-support factorization from presentability
statement: For a Grothendieck derived category, a map from an α-presentable object U to a coproduct ∐ Y factors through a finite subcoproduct: there exist a finite type J, a : J → I, and g : U ⟶ ∐ fun j ↦ Y (a j) such that g ≫ Sigma.desc (fun j ↦ Sigma.ι Y (a j)) = f.

proof.text: Construct the filtered category of finite subcoproducts and apply α-presentability of Hom(U, -) to its coproduct colimit.

theorem derived_factor_through_small_subcoproduct
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A]
    (α : Cardinal.{v}) [Fact α.IsRegular]
    (I : Type v) (Y : I → DerivedCategory A)
    (U : DerivedCategory A) (hU : IsCardinalPresentable U α)
    (f : U ⟶ ∐ Y) :
    ∃ (J : Type v) (_ : Finite J) (a : J → I), HasCardinalLT J α ∧
      ∃ g : U ⟶ ∐ fun j ↦ Y (a j),
        g ≫ Sigma.desc (fun j ↦ Sigma.ι Y (a j)) = f
